description: POST /api/tickets returns 201 with status OPEN and an HD-###### id for a valid customer request
steps: Log in as seeded customer C-1 and obtain a bearer token
POST /api/tickets with title, description, category Billing, priority High
Assert response 201, status OPEN, id matches ^HD-\d{6}$, customer_id is C-1

description: Ticket creates without a token or with invalid fields are rejected and write no ticket row
steps: POST /api/tickets with no Authorization header and assert 401
POST /api/tickets with category Refunds and assert 422 VALIDATION_ERROR naming category
Assert the ticket count is unchanged after both requests

description: Billing, Technical, and Account tickets are stored in the queue mapped to their category with one ROUTED history row
steps: Create one ticket each for Billing, Technical, and Account
Assert each stored queue_id matches the team of the same name
Assert each ticket has exactly one TicketHistory row with event ROUTED

description: A ticket whose category has no routing rule returns 409 ROUTING_RULE_MISSING and writes no row
steps: Delete the Billing routing rule in a test fixture
POST /api/tickets with category Billing and assert 409 with code ROUTING_RULE_MISSING
Assert the ticket count is unchanged

description: Claiming an OPEN ticket sets the assignee, moves it to IN_PROGRESS, and writes one Assignment row with from null
steps: Create an OPEN ticket as customer C-1
POST /api/tickets/{id}/claim as agent G-1 and assert 200
Assert assignee is G-1, status is IN_PROGRESS, and one Assignment row has from null and to G-1

description: Reassigning a ticket changes the assignee, keeps the status, and appends a second Assignment row
steps: Claim a ticket as G-1, then POST /reassign with assignee_id G-2 as G-2
Assert status is unchanged and the response is 200
Assert a second Assignment row exists with from G-1 and to G-2

description: Each of the six valid status transitions returns 200 and writes one TicketHistory row
steps: For each valid edge, set up a ticket in the from-state
POST /api/tickets/{id}/status with the to-state as agent and assert 200
Assert exactly one TicketHistory row records from-state, to-state, and actor

description: A transition outside the valid set returns 409 INVALID_TICKET_STATE and leaves the status unchanged
steps: Create an OPEN ticket and POST /api/tickets/{id}/status with to_status RESOLVED as agent
Assert response 409 with code INVALID_TICKET_STATE
Assert status is still OPEN and no history row was written

description: Both SLA timers start at ticket creation with the targets of the policy version snapshotted for its priority
steps: Create a High ticket at T0 with the seeded v1 policy (60 and 480)
Assert two TIMER_STARTED SlaEvent rows exist, both at T0
GET /api/tickets/{id}/sla and assert response target 60 and resolution target 480

description: The response timer is BREACHED at exactly the target minute and stops at the first public agent reply, not at an internal note
steps: Create a Critical ticket at T0 with response target 15; read SLA at T0 + 11 min and assert ON_TRACK, at T0 + 12 min and assert AT_RISK, and at T0 + 14 min 59 s and assert AT_RISK
Read SLA at T0 + 15 min and assert BREACHED
On a second ticket, post an internal note at +5 min and a public reply at +20 min; assert stopped_at is +20 min

description: A response breach sets escalated to true, keeps the status, and moves the ticket to Billing Tier 2
steps: Create a Billing ticket with no public agent reply and advance the test Clock to the response deadline
Read the ticket and assert escalated is true and status is unchanged
Assert queue is Billing Tier 2 and one BREACHED_RESPONSE and one ESCALATED SlaEvent exist

description: Repeated reads after a breach write no new SlaEvent rows
steps: Escalate a ticket as in F011, then count SlaEvent rows
Read the ticket again at a later Clock time
Assert the SlaEvent row count is unchanged

description: An agent internal note returns 201 and its body never appears in any customer response
steps: As agent G-1 assigned to the ticket, POST /api/tickets/{id}/notes with body Checked refund log and assert 201
As customer C-1 (owner), GET the ticket and its replies through all customer endpoints
Assert the note body appears in no customer response

description: PUT, PATCH, and DELETE on a note or reply id return 405 and change no row
steps: Create a note and a reply on a ticket
Send PUT, PATCH, and DELETE to each id and assert 405 for every request
Assert the note and reply rows are unchanged

description: A customer reply on a PENDING_CUSTOMER ticket returns 201, moves the ticket to OPEN, and writes one history row in one transaction
steps: Set ticket HD-000010 owned by C-1 to PENDING_CUSTOMER
POST /api/tickets/HD-000010/replies as C-1 with body Attached the invoice and assert 201
Assert status is OPEN and one TicketHistory row records PENDING_CUSTOMER to OPEN

description: A customer reply on a RESOLVED ticket returns 409 INVALID_TICKET_STATE and stores no reply
steps: Set a ticket owned by C-1 to RESOLVED
POST /api/tickets/{id}/replies as C-1 and assert 409 with code INVALID_TICKET_STATE
Assert no TicketReply row was written

description: An agent publishing a RESOLVED ticket returns 201 with source_ticket_id fixed to that ticket
steps: Set ticket HD-000030 to RESOLVED
POST /api/kb/articles as agent A-1 with source_ticket_id HD-000030, title, body, and tags
Assert response 201 and source_ticket_id is HD-000030

description: Customer calls to KB create, update, and delete return 403 and leave the article table unchanged
steps: As customer C-1, POST /api/kb/articles and assert 403
As customer C-1, PUT and DELETE an existing article and assert 403 for each
Assert the article table is unchanged

description: Creating an SLA policy version for High returns 201 with version 2 and leaves version 1 unchanged
steps: As admin, POST /api/admin/sla-policies with priority High, response_minutes 45, resolution_minutes 360
Assert response 201 with version 2
GET /api/admin/sla-policies?priority=High and assert v1 still shows 60 and 480

description: PATCH, PUT, and DELETE on a published SLA policy version return 409 POLICY_VERSION_IMMUTABLE and change no row
steps: As admin, send PATCH, PUT, and DELETE to the v1 High policy version id
Assert each response is 409 with code POLICY_VERSION_IMMUTABLE
Assert the v1 row is unchanged
